subject: Renewal & consolidation: Amplitude quote + Segment migration SOW
messages:
From: Susan Clark <susan.clark@amplitude.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Amplitude Renewal: quote for 2026

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the continued partnership. Attached is the renewal quote for our existing Amplitude subscription covering 2026. The baseline renewal keeps your current events allowance and includes 10% off list pricing for multi-year commit.

Highlights:
- Term: 12 months (Mar 1, 2026 — Feb 28, 2027)
- Events/mo: 250M
- List price: $68,400/yr — Proposed renewal: $61,560/yr
- Optional migration assistance (Segment -> Amplitude) available as a professional services add-on (see SOW stub)

Please review the attached PDF and let me know if you'd like me to draft a consolidated offer that includes the migration work. Happy to set up 30 min next week.

Attachments: [Attachment: Amplitude_Consolidated_Quote_2026.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

Best,
Susan Clark
Account Executive, Amplitude
susan.clark@amplitude.com
Mobile: (415) 555-0210

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Susan Clark <susan.clark@amplitude.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Amplitude Renewal: quote for 2026

Susan —

Thanks for sending this over. A couple of notes from our side:

1) We're exploring consolidation of our event pipeline and product analytics — specifically migrating our tracking layer from Segment to a direct Amplitude ingestion to reduce latency and per-event transformations. If you can provide a bundled price for: renewal + migration SOW + 6 months post-migration health checks, that will help our finance team evaluate total TCO.

2) Budget guidance: we have ~ $55k allocated for analytics tooling renewals in Q2 for the platform team, but there may be room to stretch for a multi-product consolidation if we can get a multi-year discount or phased invoicing.

3) Please include a draft SOW and an itemized breakdown of professional services hours for the Segment migration. We'll need this for approvals and to confirm scope (events validation, transform mapping, source decommissioning).

I've attached our internal eval notes and am looping in Rishi from Finance to confirm PO process. Marissa, can you weigh in on expected procurement lead time?

Attachments: [Attachment: Amplitude_Eval_Notes_2025.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Product
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Susan Clark <susan.clark@amplitude.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Lee <daniel.lee@segment.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Amplitude Renewal: quote for 2026

Laura —

Appreciate the context. I've pulled together a consolidated offer and a draft SOW for the migration; attaching both. Key points:

- Consolidated price (renewal + migration + 6mo health checks) = $98,500 for year 1 with a committed 2-year term and 12% discount off list across services.
- Migration scope (high level): data mapping (Segment -> Amplitude schemas), QA validation, replay/backfill of critical events, decommission plan for Segment sources. Estimated 4 weeks of effort with a 3-person delivery team.
- Payment: we can do phased invoicing (50% upon SOW sign, 40% on cutover, 10% after 6mo health checks).

I've also looped in Daniel from Segment to confirm the recommended approach for safe cutover — we don't expect Segment to charge if Redwood chooses to stop forwarding events (he can confirm terms).

Next steps: confirm scope + target cutover quarter (we recommended Q2 2026 to avoid holiday freeze), then we can issue a final quote and DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Attachments: [Attachment: Amplitude_Consolidated_Quote_2026.pdf (PDF, 92KB)], [Attachment: Segment_Migration_SOW_v1.docx (DOCX, 48KB)]

Best,
Susan Clark
Account Executive, Amplitude

Susan / Daniel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOW. From a platform/product perspective this looks reasonable; two procurement items for our side before we can sign:

1) Rishi — can you confirm budget approval for the consolidated figure ($98.5k year 1) or suggest a target that would be approvable this quarter? We prefer phased invoicing if possible.

2) Legal / procurement will want to see our PO template filled — attaching Redwood_PO_Template.docx. If you can provide a final invoice + the DocuSign envelope, we can route to legal and issue PO on our side.

Marissa, is this something you can own for procurement coordination? Timelines: if we get final docs this week, we should be able to sign and start work mid-March.

Laura / team —

I reviewed the consolidated number and we can approve up to $100k this quarter from platform reserves provided we get the phased invoice schedule you requested. Please ask Amplitude to:

- Update invoice terms to phased (50/40/10)
- Include a short cancellation clause that allows us to revert to Segment forwarding for 30 days with limited liability during cutover

Susan — if you can send the DocuSign link and updated invoice, I'll sign off on the PO on Friday. Let's get procurement to issue PO v1 and route to legal if any redlines appear.

Thanks,
